messages.text: We agree on Relief, and the Ascendant has now confirmed Grey Petrel is lodged correctly. I support that written directive. The repair requirement next month must be treated as part of the cost of today's accommodation; repeated demands on a weakening route are not sustainable. Our trade contributes to the military opportunity without becoming compulsory carriage.

Your confirmation resolves my funding objection. I support Relief under the lodged reserve arrangement. The expected Beacon one makes next month's funded Repair an essential subject for the post-resolution bargain.

conversation.reason: Both the Navigation discussion and the addressed imperial note now support the same funded operation. I have no remaining objection to Relief on today's locked assets. This assent concerns an operational order only and grants no constitutional signature or standing commitment.

messages.text: The crown has confirmed Grey Petrel's lodged Relief lift, so the funding objection is answered. I support the written Relief directive. I acknowledge your maintenance and our protection as contributions, but Repair next month cannot be an unquestioned settlement already: it restores the route while denying external passage that month. We must negotiate how the army keeps its strength alongside that repair.
Reserve confirmation resolves my operational objection. Navigation supports Relief. Preserve the council Raid and Warrant alongside it; Vigil must not also be assigned Guard.

conversation.reason: Our current arrangement buys food, trade and successful combat according to the disclosed condition. Its route cost is real. I am accepting this round's exchange without promising an army stand-down next month or signing away our institutional claim.

addressed_notes.text: Confirmed: my locked reserve is Relief lift. My intended final Navigation directive remains Relief. Both Security delegates support Raid with the separate Warrant. GN's warning about repair next month is accepted; please bring a concrete Lantern commitment into the constitutional discussion.
